rubric: Every changed file is planned and nothing risky was added.

criteria.planned_or_declared: Is every changed file either planned (in the planned files) or declared with a reason that justifies it? The undeclared files are listed; any of them is a no.
criteria.no_new_dependency: Does the change add no dependency, or only ones the plan or a declared reason calls for? The new dependencies are listed.
criteria.no_secret_or_pii: Do the secret-looking additions contain no real secret or personal data? Answer yes when the list is empty or holds only obvious placeholders.
criteria.no_test_removed: Does the change remove no test? The removed tests are listed; a test removed with the code it covered still counts as removed unless a declared reason explains it.
criteria.no_todo: Does the change leave no TODO, FIXME or XXX that stands in for work the slice should have done? The added ones are listed.
criteria.unrelated_refactors: Is every change in service of the plan: no renames, reformatting, moves or clean-ups of code the plan's steps do not touch? Read the summary and the changed files; a change that only tidies code beside the work is a no.

reading.why: Every changed file is planned, nothing was declared, removed, added or left standing, and the summary names only the endpoint and its test.
